name: Ossining
title: Hudson River Paddling Conditions Near Ossining, NY
blurb: Louis Engel Waterfront Park, at the northern end of the Tappan Zee. Croton Point reaches out across the river a few miles north.

tide.label: NOAA 8518919 Tarrytown
tide.note: Tide from NOAA station 8518919 at Tarrytown, about five miles downriver.
tide.cardNote: Unless you plan on landing on a beach or poking into a shallow creek, tide is likely not very important to you.
